Subject: patch@32017 - CPANPLUS::Dist::Build fixes for VMS

Jos, Just in case anything is missing, this is what it takes to patch  CPANPLUS::Dist::Build in blead to work on VMS. I think that the only change from what I have previously submitted is  the inc/conf.pl patch. In Build.pm: The build procedure needs to have '.com' appended to it, and $buildflags  needs to be passed in double quotes C<">. In inc/conf.pl: I reworked the previous patch for handing of directories on VMS to be  both more accurate, and actually a bit simpler. In 02_CPANPLUS-Dist-Build.t: Use catfile instead of catdir in several places. -John ho0ebg@qsl.net Personal Opinion Only
